- **Careful distillation:** Skilled producers carefully separate the "heads" and "tails" during distillation to limit unwanted congeners and methanol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXp0Fh7FRhsxnPTsgPw0mAbVkoVfXqEecB0K1rCABsqlIlcOif0PgFY9_zAqGJCs2PDpRf6FzDUGpDxEIuaCHU3OpCiN94Dkz5OsLo_uLrNV8PaUyMldHS1J2xceT1DF05)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF1wBBZ2f95Ks3RvhN8pYWeVUlHsuF2WmsK3ObSvMWHKS7-vsOsdzlidV2lbDxQbbUg6A1UYxtVLXTREuUwzYBuBZz3WW0Jc7JAHTj04rnlmHRDPBDpFGkb-xGdR1A639JPsjLVA4qp_pSAiic5IQ_l0Y0Gp0lttk6i-I8NCehtD5qwATrvSI54rGasj366D-_1lI)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1wohsCEh4bUOWdqzU0sZg1iYZ-LI1t7NpdVevn3pjDfPif1scC_GzQC4odoyYtiBgz6cRGfDA8myEo253cYYq4cV42xzLJxYXUuvh8fabKmwIfsVxeFf3mL0XixLgOh4SH6yBD6o3NHdY6utc2UMcCg038aKactmn18egCqU4phDwI4)
- **Slower sipping habits:** Mezcal is often sipped slowly rather than chugged, which slows alcohol intake.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1_lDnk1D1a5D4yjGQvyH7LKCtYrM_-8zbVrR0xDquIkwHq4cQ8rivZzsOxv0pFWRdk18dr57sg--RUpAmghmOxadIEqreoNZC1n9u0zWUhsmoL4gw7hvmexxfk8ykt1CmJRpT99mC8-n6Tz303Gjzw0QIYdHhD774KyuGv56)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXBm11V_901ziMgfgR0HGq3WyHmn36fpF4Dhv_2ibFNF5ZUs6IKnyBSI3-bwz0th0az1RglurqB0LlKGvWAzP0XjVtyZESjMNxomeuDv3n2gltUiDVGYMRpvx2zOFk6tmMYdla6Hw4PXelstHgpMof)

### How to Prevent a Mezcal Hangover

- **Pace yourself:** Sip slowly and set a limit before you start.
- **Drink water:** Alternate sips or glasses of mezcal with water to stay hydrated.
- **Eat beforehand:** Have a meal or light snacks with the drink rather than drinking on an empty stomach.
